thread:
maya: Quick note from today's design review: our help micro-panel uses mixed terms (Guides / Docs / KB). Users are bouncing when they can't find 'Playbook' entries. Screenshot in thread.

kevin: This is causing real confusion in support. The in-panel search doesn't pick up doc aliases. I think we should pull aliases from frontmatter and display common synonyms under the header.

rachel: Agreed. Proposal: header reads 'Quick guides' and a subdued line 'includes Playbooks & Runbooks' underneath. Make header clickable to /docs/guides. Add an 'Open full docs' CTA with utm=help-panel.

maya: Accessibility: autofocus the search input, add aria-label to the panel, and ensure the header link is keyboard accessible. I can add the ARIA snippet.

docs-bot: Note: indexer will honor frontmatter.aliases. Docs team can batch-add aliases via CSV migration. Also we'll emit event help_panel_search with the raw query so we can measure which terms users try.

kevin: Action items: docs to add aliases for top 50 pages; frontend to change header, show synonyms line, autofocus input, and add CTA. Target patch release in 2 weeks.

maya: I'll PR the small UI tweak and include the aria/focus tests. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
